shared_conventions.citation_format: Sourced values carry source_chapter + paragraph (structured_story chNNN-pNN) + a verbatim quote. Designed values carry inferred:true + reason. Sub-field inference uses *_inferred / *_reason keys (e.g. color_inferred on an otherwise sourced eyes object).
shared_conventions.gender: Every card has gender = male|female. Ensemble cards also carry gender_mix (counts) and, where mixed, per-slot gender. For a mixed ensemble, the top-level gender is the majority value (or the nominal value when the split is even) and is explained in gender_note. No presented_gender is needed in this batch: no cross-dressing or cross-gender performer is involved.
shared_conventions.scale_anchor: All scale_reference values use CHAR-alice's true size of 135 cm (the anchor set in CHAR-alice/appearance.json). Every change in Alice's size is SUP-003 forced perspective. Performer heights never change.
shared_conventions.card_figures: The House of Hearts pack (gardeners, soldiers, courtiers, royal children, court officers) shares one construction: a stiff, flat, oblong ivory card-face tabard with suit pips and corner indices, arms and legs at the corners (ch008-p11), and a single shared pack back-design on the back (ch008-p16). That back-design is designed here as a crimson-and-cream lattice with a small heart rosette. It is worn over 1862 crimson Hearts livery (FAC-house-of-hearts emblem_visual). Suit per group: gardeners and soldiers are clubs, courtiers diamonds, royal children and court officers hearts, and the guest monarchs clubs, diamonds and spades in their own colours. Numerals are unique within a suit: the named gardeners are 2, 5 and 7; background gardeners use 3/4/6/8/9/10.
shared_conventions.animal_coding: SUP-002: every animal cue comes from casting, grooming, hair shape, spectacles, or waistcoat and cravat colour and pattern. There are no masks, fur, feathers, beaks, ears, tails or CGI anywhere.
shared_conventions.sup014: No weapons or execution devices on any card. Soldiers' 'clubs' are short ceremonial batons that never touch anyone. Officers carry white usher's wands. The executioner has no axe (see DEF-p3-appearance-301).
shared_conventions.doubling_5_3_B: None of the 14 characters in this batch belongs to a ruling 5.3 B doubling pair. Housemaid -> Mary Ann is covered by CHAR-family-housemaid, Dinah -> Cheshire Cat by CHAR-cheshire-cat and the creature registry, and the sister glimpsed at the trial by CHAR-alice-sister, whose card says what carries across. This batch adds guard rules: the sister is not a juror and no juror resembles her (CHAR-jury-ensemble); no royal child resembles Alice (CHAR-royal-procession-ensemble); no crowd member has white hair or a white coat, which is reserved for the White Rabbit (CHAR-crowd-ensemble). It also adds one designed dream recurrence: the two guinea-pigs of ch004 are the same performers as jurors J01 and J02 (TERM-0036 treats them as one pair).
shared_conventions.style_ref_note: refs/style/alice.jpeg shows a literal giant caterpillar creature in a fantasy hall. Only its mood is taken here: candle-and-shaft light and weathered, muted period textures. Its literal creature treatment conflicts with SUP-002, so it is not followed. The ruling on this belongs to 06-art/art-director (style.json is still skeleton_empty) and is noted here for their attention.
shared_conventions.costume_boundary: default_outfit_tone gives only the base look and colour tone. Cut, fabric and changes of outfit belong to 06-art/costume (Phase 4).

key_decisions: Executioner: aged 58-65, taken from the source's 'at his time of life' (ch008-p66). SUP-014 overrides the axe/block in the index's performer concept (DEF-p3-appearance-301).

Jury: all 11 unnamed jurors are male, sourced from 'jury-men' (ch011-p04). Split into 6 animal-coded and 5 bird-coded jurors ('some were animals, and some were birds'), with exactly two guinea-pigs. Species already used for named characters are avoided.

Caucus remainder: coded as Thames-backwater species (moorhen, coot, water-vole, wren, heron, sand-martin). This ties the pool to the waking backwater under ruling 5.2 A and SUP-007. All of them are soaked, per ch003-p01.
Royal procession: exactly 10 diamond courtiers and 10 heart children. The children are aged 5-9 and all shorter than Alice.
Crowd ensemble: appears on screen in ch004 only. The ch006 chorus is sung by the cook and the baby (DEF-p3-appearance-302).

Frog-Footman: follows the index (crimson Hearts livery, matched with CHAR-fish-footman). The frog touch is large grey-green eyes behind magnifying spectacles plus a mottled green waistcoat. The Duchess-household reading is filed for arbitration (DEF-p3-appearance-303-a).

Gardener trio: told apart by hair (sandy, black, auburn with side-whiskers), age and height. Seven is capped below the Knave's height so the Knave card's statement that he is taller than the gardeners' card figures still holds.
Pat: heard, not seen, in the source. He is designed as a plain labourer with no stage-Irish caricature; his idiom carries his identity.
